evidence_semantics.human_rejection_precedence: A completed human rejection excludes support even when provider and automated evidence pass.
evidence_semantics.provisional_score_semantics: Uncalibrated similarity and margin; not a probability.
evidence_semantics.provider_assertion: GBIF provider-asserted provisional support, never human verified.
evidence_semantics.strict_support: Completed human review, verified target identity and no exclusion blockers.

limitations: The adaptive builder and permits are contract- and fixture-tested; no live production GBIF support bank was populated in Phase 3.
No embedding, prototype, classifier, calibrator or Flickr score was produced in Phase 3.
No model-quality, time-saved or review-work-saved improvement is claimed from Phase 3 tests.
A provisional readiness permit cannot authorize scientific release or calibrated output.
